entities.name: ADP-L-glycero-D-manno-heptose-6-epimerase
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q1LQG2 from Cupriavidus metallidurans; reference annotation assigns EC 5.1.3.20.
Catalyzes reversible C6 epimerization between ADP-D-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose and ADP-L-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose; annotated NADP(+) cofactor.

entities.name: RHEA:17577
observations: ADP-D-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose ⇌ ADP-L-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose; epimerization at heptose carbon 6, EC 5.1.3.20.

entities.name: NADP(+)
observations: Annotated cofactor; reference enzyme binds one NADP(+) per subunit.
